annotations.title: Get a free API key (proof of work, no human approval)

description: Create a free Screwtape.ai API key (10 calls per UTC day) with no human approval. Call it only when no Screwtape key is configured and you can compute SHA-256 with a code tool, because the proof of work must be computed exactly, not guessed. Do NOT call it when a key already exists, to get more quota (it is limited to 5 keys per IP per hour and per UTC day), or without a valid pow_nonce. A missing nonce returns an error that describes the challenge. Inputs: pow_nonce (required string matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,64}$; SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string screwtape-signup-v1:<current UTC YYYY-MM-DD>:<nonce> must start with 12 zero bits, which is 3 hex zeros), email (optional), name (optional, at most 80 characters). Returns: api_key (shown once; store it securely and send it as Authorization: Bearer), key metadata and request_id. Only the key's SHA-256 hash is stored. Cost: free. Needs no key and no payment.

data_sharing.description: Optional, off by default. Only true turns on opt-in data sharing for the new key: redacted samples of its calls are kept 90 days. Turn it off anytime with PATCH /v1/keys/me/data-sharing. See https://screwtape.ai/privacy/#opt-in-data-sharing.

email.description: Optional. Omit it to store no email.

name.description: Optional agent or client name, at most 80 characters.

pow_nonce.description: Required. SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string screwtape-signup-v1:YYYY-MM-DD:<nonce> must have 12 leading zero bits. Nonce matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,64}$. YYYY-MM-DD is the UTC day.
